source.product: No real product. An invented warm-Japandi solid white-oak three-drawer dresser backing a synthetic stub listing.
source.generation: Four-view turnaround (codex-image), cropped at detected gutter boundaries, Higgsfield multi_image_to_3d (Meshy), should_texture+enable_pbr, target_polycount 24000
source.postProcessing: gltf-transform resize to 1024 px textures (resize only, no lossy re-encode, geometry untouched), then scripts/fit_glb.py 120 48 80
source.dimensionsVerifiedAt: Not a retail product; nothing external to verify against. Declared dimensions are what the mesh measures.
source.priceVerifiedAt: None. price_cents on the stub listing is invented demo data.

knownLimitations: Generic visual proxy, not a real SKU. It may only back a synthetic stub listing.

The first turnaround sheet came back with a transparent (alpha) background and coloured edge fringing, which defeats the gutter detection in scripts/turnaround_crop.mjs. The sheet was regenerated with an explicit opaque-white-background instruction; this model is built from that second sheet.
fit_glb.py applied a per-axis scale with 7.23 percent anisotropy to reach the listed box exactly. The mesh is therefore very slightly stretched relative to what the generator produced.
The three-quarter source view showed a faintly bowed drawer front rather than a dead-flat one, so the front face may not be perfectly planar in the mesh.
Drawer fronts and their finger grooves are texture and shallow relief only. Nothing opens, and there is no drawer interior.
The underside and the inside faces are generated, not observed. Expect approximate geometry where the source sheet showed nothing.
Visual quality has NOT been verified in a render. Only measurements, triangle count and byte size were checked against the file.
